properties.name: Quasi-identifier disclosure risk report
properties.description: Uses a records array and a personal-data report to identify remaining quasi-identifier columns and combinations that could uniquely single out records after direct personal data is removed.

properties.name: quasi_identifier_detector
properties.description: Identifies quasi-identifier columns and combinations that could uniquely identify records after direct personal data is removed. It uses the personal-data report to avoid treating direct identifiers as quasi-identifiers.
